articles.headline: Footy for Fido: Adidas drops dog kits for 2026-27
articles.description: Adidas has released its Clubs Pet Collection with seven different mini kits specialized for your beloved canines.

articles.headline: CAS to hear pro/rel appeal from five Mexico second division clubs
articles.description: Five clubs from Mexico's second division have filed an appeal against the Mexican Football Federation (FMF) and top-flight Liga MX regarding promotion and relegation, the CAS confirmed to ESPN on Friday.

articles.headline: Son Heung-min brace lifts MLS All-Stars past Liga MX in 4-3 thriller
articles.description: Son Heung-min scored two goals in three minutes in the first half to propel the MLS All-Stars past the LIGA MX All-Stars 4-3 in the Major League Soccer All-Star Game.

images.name: Son MLS All-Stars [1296x729]
images.caption: Son Heung-min scored the first two goals for the MLS All-Stars in their victory over Liga MX in Charlotte.

articles.headline: Liga MX Femenil rebrands, changes season format
articles.description: Mexican women's top-flight side Liga MX Femenil announced a rebrand to Liga Femenil BBVA, along with a change in the competition's regular season format.

articles.headline: Mexico great Guillermo Ochoa retires after 22-year career
articles.description: Guillermo Ochoa, widely considered among the greatest Mexican goalkeepers in history, announced his retirement from elite soccer on Tuesday, bringing an end to a distinguished 22-year professional career.

articles.headline: Keylor Navas headlines Liga MX squad for MLS ASG
articles.description: Costa Rican goalkeeper Keylor Navas, a three-time World Cup participant, and Mexican teen phenom Gilberto Mora headline the Liga MX squad set to face MLS stars in the All-Star Game on July 29 in Charlotte, North Carolina.
